## Review checklist
- [ ] Intended changes reviewed; unrelated work preserved
- [ ] No credentials, secrets, or unintended private files included
- [ ] Remote changes checked and relevant updates integrated
- [ ] Applicable checks run, or missing checks explained
- [ ] Contributor checkpoint label checked against available history
- [ ] Ready for teammate review, or marked as a draft
